title: ResearchRunMetadata
description: Audit record for one EdgeLab ingestion/collection run.

status.description: 'no_op' (EdgeLab Prospective Model Snapshots milestone): the run completed with zero errors and genuinely had nothing to do (no game had a due checkpoint) -- distinct from 'success', which means at least one snapshot was actually captured. 'partial' means at least one game succeeded and at least one genuinely failed (not merely skipped/ineligible). 'failed' means every game that was attempted failed. Never write 'success' merely because the process reached the end -- see lib/edgelab/prospective_snapshot.py / scripts/edgelab/run_prospective_snapshots.py.

exclusionSummary.description: PHASE H (archive completeness): the deterministic aggregate of every market this run EXCLUDED rather than archived. The registry gate has always built a full record per excluded market -- ticker, series, title, reason -- and then reported only the integer counts.marketsExcluded, so 'N markets were excluded' could never be interrogated. Persisting every row would grow unbounded on a bad day, so this carries counts by reason, the series each reason affected, a few sampled tickers, and a sha256 digest over the sorted exclusion set. Identical digests mean identical exclusions regardless of sampling or snapshot ordering. Built by lib.edgelab.market_universe.summarize_exclusions.

digest.description: sha256 over the sorted reason|series|ticker fingerprint set.
